key_findings: Single index case: fetus/female newborn with hydrometrocolpos from imperforate hymen; mother facts use subject mother, antenatal ultrasound findings use subject fetus and postnatal facts index_patient, matching the corpus convention for neonatal index cases (ROSTER-RELATIVES).
All 49 facts checked against their quotes for polarity, subject, flags, times and units; no fact added or removed. "Told that her fetus is in good condition" is hearsay kept only as an ambiguity.

The mild calyceal dilation condition (role complication) is literal ("no complications were seen except mild calyceal dilation of the renal pelvis"); it coexists with the antenatal and neonatal ultrasound observations by design. Hymenectomy indication and finding come from their own quotes.

residual_risks: Relation p1-e09 (post-procedure ultrasound) before p1-e10 (discharge) rests on the in-hospital-care-before-discharge ruling; the source joins them only with "and".
